notes:
Summary: Mid-market SaaS (customer support workflows) evaluating Redwood for a RAG-driven support agent and ticket deflection. Primary goals: very high-quality top-5 retrieval (human-evaluated), <250ms end-to-end median response for chat+retrieval, and <20ms vector query p95 if possible. Indexing scale target: ~40-70M documents (tickets, KBs, transcripts) with nightly incremental updates. Cost sensitivity: aim <= $0.002 - $0.006 per query (vector retrieval + rerank).

Requirements / asks from initial calls:
- Embedding + ANN store recommendations for 50M vectors (indexing time, shard strategy, projected throughput).
- Reranking approach: lightweight cross-encoder on a small candidate set (top-100 -> top-5) at 95th percentile latency budget. Interested in Redwood Optimize automated suggestions for quantization / batching.
- Precedence: want same API between hosted -> dedicated; may start hosted for exploratory queries but need dedicated for production SLOs and data isolation.

Customer quotes / paraphrases:
- "We need consistent 200ms responses for our in-chat suggestions or deflection fails." (Director of CX)
- "If top-5 quality drops, CS deflection falls off; we measure at 7-day ticket reduction." (Head of Knowledge Ops)

Commercial / procurement notes:
- Budget conversation started; procurement prefers a committed monthly band. Forecasting $120-300k ARR first year depending on dedicated sizing.
- Competitive checks: evaluating Pinecone + custom FAISS on GKE, talking to Weaviate for vector DB. Redwood advantage must be predictable unit cost and rerank path.

Technical concerns flagged by SE during discovery:
- End-to-end latency: embedding compute + ANN lookup + reranker cost -> need POC with realistic distribution (short chat prompts + long KB hits).
- Incremental indexing: delta ingestion window and TTL/retention policies for attachments.
- Audit / retention: legal requires 7 year retention for some transcripts, need retention controls + residency in NA.

Next actions recorded:
- 2026-03-03: Demo + small rerank perf run (Priya) -> captured metrics (attached).
- 2026-03-10: Security questionnaire sent; Arcadia to return by 2026-03-18.
- 2026-03-17: Deliver POC plan + cost model for 50M docs (Redwood to produce).
